coverageSearch: Searched current course titles, descriptions and available outline topics for dental, oral, orofacial, cariology, periodontology, restorative, endodontic and clinical skills content. Checked the nearest anatomy, laboratory, biomedical, population health and communication offerings directly.

findings.label: Biomedical Science and Patient-Centred Health
findings.reason: A feasible plan develops biomedical knowledge, laboratory techniques, research design and communication. Functional Anatomy and Life Science Laboratory supply anatomical and experimental work, but do not teach dental anatomy in clinical practice, restoration or treatment.

findings.label: Health Equity, Prevention and Access to Care
findings.reason: A feasible plan combines epidemiology, health behaviour, inequality and public policy. It develops a population-health perspective without the dental prevention, diagnosis and treatment that define the target.

alignment: The biomedical plan provides real cells, organs, immunity, pathology, microbiology, lab methods and study design. The health equity plan adds prevention, public economics and behavioural context. Neither builds a progression in oral disease, restoration, dental radiology, treatment or clinical practice. This is an academic conclusion independent of licensing. No public UCR schedule or alignment is selected.
